prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1023; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck pain and stiffness. Over the course of twelve visits, care consisted of conservative management including gentle range-of-motion exercises, soft tissue therapy, and home stretching instructions. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion, which are consistent with a soft tissue strain. Neurological screening, including reflexes, sensation, and strength testing in the upper extremities, returned normal results. No prior injury to the cervical region has been reported in the patient's history. Treatment followed an expected and typical course, with frequency of visits decreasing as symptoms improved and the patient was discharged to independent home exercise. At this time, it cannot be determined with certainty whether the reported symptoms are attributable to this collision, and further records may be needed to clarify causation. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered.
